items.name: bQ_andb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_andb : forall a b, bQ (andb a b) == (bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bQ_negb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_negb : forall b, bQ (negb b) == (1 - bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bQ_orb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_orb : forall a b, bQ (orb a b) == (bQ a + bQ b - bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bool_dist_le
items.statement: Definition bool_dist_le {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop := exists g : Corner n -> bool, l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)) <= d.

items.name: bool_dist_embed
items.statement: Definition bool_dist_le {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop := exists g : Corner n -> bool, l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)) <= d. Lemma bool_dist_embed : forall n (g : Corner n -> bool), bool_dist_le (embed g) 0.

items.name: l1_norm_ext
items.statement: Lemma l1_norm_ext : forall n (F G : MV n), (forall m, F m == G m) -> l1_norm F == l1_norm G.

items.name: bool_dist_le_mono
items.statement: Lemma bool_dist_le_mono : forall n (F : MV n) (d d' : Q), bool_dist_le F d -> d <= d' -> bool_dist_le F d'.

items.name: bool_dist_add_absorb
items.statement: Lemma bool_dist_add_absorb : forall n (F G : MV n) (dF : Q), bool_dist_le F dF -> bool_dist_le (mv_add F G) (dF + l1_norm G).

items.name: bool_dist_add_absorb_r
items.statement: Lemma bool_dist_add_absorb_r : forall n (F G : MV n) (dG : Q), bool_dist_le G dG -> bool_dist_le (mv_add F G) (l1_norm F + dG).

items.name: bool_dist_wrt
items.statement: Definition bool_dist_wrt {n} (F : MV n) (g : Corner n -> bool) : Q := l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)).

items.name: bool_dist_le_iff
items.statement: Definition bool_dist_wrt {n} (F : MV n) (g : Corner n -> bool) : Q := l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)). Lemma bool_dist_le_iff : forall n (F : MV n) (d : Q), bool_dist_le F d <-> exists g, bool_dist_wrt F g <= d.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_self
items.statement: Definition bool_dist_wrt {n} (F : MV n) (g : Corner n -> bool) : Q := l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)). Lemma bool_dist_le_iff : forall n (F : MV n) (d : Q), bool_dist_le F d <-> exists g, bool_dist_wrt F g <= d. Proof. intros n F d. unfold bool_dist_le, bool_dist_wrt. tauto. Qed. Lemma bool_dist_wrt_self : forall n (g : Corner n -> bool), bool_dist_wrt (embed g) g == 0.

items.name: mv_sub_add_split
items.statement: Lemma mv_sub_add_split : forall n (F G : MV n) (gF gG : Corner n -> bool) (m : Mask n), mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_add (embed gF) (embed gG)) m == mv_add (mv_sub F (embed gF)) (mv_sub G (embed gG)) m.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_add
items.statement: Lemma bool_dist_wrt_add : forall n (F G : MV n) (gF gG : Corner n -> bool), l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_add (embed gF) (embed gG))) <= bool_dist_wrt F gF + bool_dist_wrt G gG.

items.name: mv_gp_ext_r
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_ext_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G1 G2 : MV n) (U : Mask n), (forall m, G1 m == G2 m) -> mv_gp sq F G1 U == mv_gp sq F G2 U.

items.name: mv_gp_ext_l
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_ext_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F1 F2 G : MV n) (U : Mask n), (forall m, F1 m == F2 m) -> mv_gp sq F1 G U == mv_gp sq F2 G U.

items.name: Qeq_minus_l
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_minus_l : forall a b c : Q, a + b == c -> a == c - b.

items.name: mv_gp_sub_r
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_sub_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (m : Mask n), mv_gp sq F (mv_sub G H) m == (mv_gp sq F G m - mv_gp sq F H m)%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_sub_l
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_sub_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (m : Mask n), mv_gp sq (mv_sub F G) H m == (mv_gp sq F H m - mv_gp sq G H m)%Q.

items.name: gp_error_split
items.statement: Lemma gp_error_split : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G eF eG : MV n) (m : Mask n), mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq eF eG) m == mv_add (mv_gp sq F (mv_sub G eG)) (mv_gp sq (mv_sub F eF) eG) m.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_gp
items.statement: Lemma bool_dist_wrt_gp : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n) (gF gG : Corner n -> bool), (forall i, Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1) -> l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq (embed gF) (embed gG))) <= l1_norm F * bool_dist_wrt G gG + bool_dist_wrt F gF * l1_norm (embed gG).

items.name: BoolFormula
items.statement: Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type := | BVar : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n (* variable x_i *) | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n (* true / false *) | BAnd : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BOr : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.name: BVar
items.statement: Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type := | BVar : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n (* variable x_i *) | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n (* true / false *) | BAnd : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BOr : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.name: BConst

items.statement: Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type := | BVar : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n (* variable x_i *) | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n (* true / false *) | BAnd : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BOr : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.statement: Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type := | BVar : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n (* variable x_i *) | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n (* true / false *) | BAnd : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BOr : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.statement: BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.statement: Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type := | BVar : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n (* variable x_i *) | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n (* true / false *) | BAnd : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BOr : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.statement: Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type := | BVar : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n (* variable x_i *) | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n (* true / false *) | BAnd : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BOr : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.statement: Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type := | BVar : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n (* variable x_i *) | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n (* true / false *) | BAnd : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BOr : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n | BNot : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.name: eval_bf
items.statement: Fixpoint eval_bf {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) (c : Corner n) : bool := match phi with | BVar i => match Vector.nth c i with Pos => true | Neg => false end | BConst b => b | BAnd p q => andb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c) | BOr p q => orb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c) | BNot p => negb (eval_bf p c) end.

items.name: translate
items.statement: Fixpoint translate {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : GA_expr n := match phi with | BVar i => Mul (Scalar (1#2)) (Add (Scalar 1) (Basis i)) | BConst true => Scalar 1 | BConst false => Scalar 0 | BAnd p q => Conv (translate p) (translate q) (* was Mul *) | BNot p => Add (Scalar 1) (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (translate p)) | BOr p q => Add (Add (translate p) (translate q)) (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (Conv (translate p) (translate q))) end.

items.name: mask_xor_self
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_self : forall n (A : Mask n), mask_xor A A = mask_empty.

items.name: xorb_eq_false_implies_eq
items.statement: Lemma xorb_eq_false_implies_eq : forall a b : bool, xorb a b = false -> a = b.

items.name: VectorDef_nth_const
items.statement: Lemma VectorDef_nth_const : forall (A : Type) (a : A) n (i : Fin.t n), VectorDef.nth (Vector.const a n) i = a.

items.name: mask_xor_eq_empty_iff
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_eq_empty_iff : forall n (A B : Mask n), mask_xor A B = mask_empty -> A = B.

items.name: sumQ_swap
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_swap : forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B -> Q) (la : list A) (lb : list B), sumQ (List.map (fun a => sumQ (List.map (fun b => f a b) lb)) la) == sumQ (List.map (fun b => sumQ (List.map (fun a => f a b) la)) lb).

items.name: corner_walsh_sum
items.statement: Definition corner_walsh_sum {n} (m1 m2 : Mask n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun s => (chi' m1 s * chi' m2 s)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: corner_walsh_sum_via_xor
items.statement: Definition corner_walsh_sum {n} (m1 m2 : Mask n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun s => (chi' m1 s * chi' m2 s)%Q) (all_corners n)). Lemma corner_walsh_sum_via_xor : forall n (m1 m2 : Mask n), corner_walsh_sum m1 m2 == sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' (mask_xor m1 m2) s) (all_corners n)).

items.name: chi_corner_sum_empty
items.statement: Lemma chi_corner_sum_empty : forall n, sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' (mask_empty (n:=n)) s) (all_corners n)) == pow2 n.

items.name: chi_corner_sum_nonempty
items.statement: Lemma chi_corner_sum_nonempty : forall n (m : Mask n), m <> mask_empty -> sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' m s) (all_corners n)) == 0.

items.name: corner_walsh_sum_closed
items.statement: Lemma corner_walsh_sum_closed : forall n (m1 m2 : Mask n), corner_walsh_sum m1 m2 == (if mask_eq_dec m1 m2 then pow2 n else 0).

items.name: Qminus_diag'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_diag' (x : Q) : (x - x)%Q == 0%Q.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_Q
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_Q : forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (U : Mask n) (k : Q), sumQ (List.map (fun m => if mask_eq_dec m U then (f m * k)%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n)) == (f U * k)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_const_Q
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_const_Q : forall n (U : Mask n) (a : Q), sumQ (List.map (fun m => if mask_eq_dec m U then a else 0%Q) (all_masks n)) == a.

items.name: Qeq_plus_r
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_plus_r : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> (a + c)%Q == (b + c)%Q.

items.name: eval_extensionality
items.statement: Lemma eval_extensionality : forall n (F G : MV n), (forall s : Corner n, eval F s == eval G s) -> forall m : Mask n, F m == G m.

items.name: chi_mask_empty
items.statement: Lemma chi_mask_empty : forall n (s : Corner n), chi' (mask_empty (n:=n)) s == 1%Q.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_chi
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_chi : forall n (s : Corner n), sumQ (List.map (fun m0 : Mask n => ((if mask_eq_dec m0 mask_empty then 1%Q else 0%Q) * chi' m0 s)%Q) (all_masks n)) == 1%Q.

items.name: embed_const_true
items.statement: Lemma embed_const_true : forall n (m : Mask n), embed (fun _ : Corner n => true) m == mv_one m.

items.name: eval_basis
items.statement: Lemma eval_basis : forall n (M : Mask n) (s : Corner n), eval (basis M) s == chi' M s.

items.name: eval_mv_one
items.statement: Lemma eval_mv_one : forall n (s : Corner n), eval (@mv_one n) s == 1%Q.

items.name: corner_walsh_sum_ortho
items.statement: Lemma corner_walsh_sum_ortho : forall n (A B : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun s => (chi' A s * chi' B s)%Q) (all_corners n)) == if mask_eq_dec A B then pow2 n else 0%Q.

items.name: chi_mask_single
items.statement: Lemma chi_mask_single : forall n (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n), chi' (mask_single i) s == sQ (Vector.nth s i).

items.name: eval_var_projector
items.statement: Lemma eval_var_projector : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n), (forall j, Vector.nth sq j == 1) -> eval (eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar (1#2)) (Add (Scalar 1) (Basis i)))) s == bQ (match Vector.nth s i with Pos => true | Neg => false end).

items.name: bQ_negb_rhs
items.statement: Lemma bQ_negb_rhs : forall b, (-1) * bQ b + 1 == bQ (negb b).

items.name: translate_eval_correct
items.statement: Lemma translate_eval_correct : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n), (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> forall s : Corner n, eval (eval_expr sq (translate phi)) s == bQ (eval_bf phi s).

items.name: translate_correct
items.statement: Theorem translate_correct : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n), (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> forall m, eval_expr sq (translate phi) m == embed (eval_bf phi) m.

items.name: bf_varcount
items.statement: Fixpoint bf_varcount {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : nat := match phi with | BVar _ => 1%nat | BConst _ => 0%nat | BAnd p q => (bf_varcount p + bf_varcount q)%nat | BOr p q => (bf_varcount p + bf_varcount q)%nat | BNot p => bf_varcount p end.

items.name: grade_bound_translate_eq_varcount
items.statement: Lemma grade_bound_translate_eq_varcount : forall n (phi : BoolFormula n), grade_bound (translate phi) = bf_varcount phi.

items.name: translate_excursion_upper
items.statement: Theorem translate_excursion_upper : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n), (max_grade_during sq (translate phi) <= bf_varcount phi)%nat.

items.name: parity_varcount_lower_bound
items.statement: Corollary parity_varcount_lower_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n), (n > 0)%nat -> eval_expr sq (translate phi) = embed (@XOR_n_func n) -> (bf_varcount phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: parity_varcount_lower_bound_semantic
items.statement: Corollary parity_varcount_lower_bound_semantic : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n), (n > 0)%nat -> (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = @XOR_n_func n -> (bf_varcount phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: sumQ_map_all_zero
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_all_zero : forall (A : Type) (f : A -> Q) (l : list A), (forall x, List.In x l -> f x == 0%Q) -> sumQ (List.map f l) == 0%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_exists_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_exists_nonzero : forall (A : Type) (f : A -> Q) (l : list A), ~(sumQ (List.map f l) == 0%Q) -> exists x, List.In x l /\ ~(f x == 0%Q).

items.name: supp
items.statement: Definition supp {n} (F : MV n) : Mask n -> Prop := fun m => ~(F m == 0%Q).

items.name: in_support
items.statement: Definition in_support {n} (F : MV n) (m : Mask n) : Prop := ~(F m == 0).

items.name: supp_union
items.statement: Definition supp_union {n} (S T : Mask n -> Prop) : Mask n -> Prop := fun m => S m \/ T m.

items.name: supp_xor
items.statement: Definition supp_xor {n} (S T : Mask n -> Prop) : Mask n -> Prop := fun U => exists A B, S A /\ T B /\ mask_xor A B = U.

items.name: conv_support_witness
items.statement: Definition supp_xor {n} (S T : Mask n -> Prop) : Mask n -> Prop := fun U => exists A B, S A /\ T B /\ mask_xor A B = U. Lemma conv_support_witness : forall n (F G : MV n) (U : Mask n), in_support (mv_conv F G) U -> exists A B, List.In A (all_masks n) /\ List.In B (all_masks n) /\ mask_xor A B = U /\ in_support F A /\ in_support G B.

items.name: support_conv_subset_xor
items.statement: Lemma support_conv_subset_xor : forall n (F G : MV n) U, supp (mv_conv F G) U -> supp_xor (supp F) (supp G) U.

items.name: supp_scale
items.statement: Lemma supp_scale : forall n (c : Q) (F : MV n) m, supp (mv_scale c F) m -> supp F m.

items.name: supp_add
items.statement: Lemma supp_add : forall n (F G : MV n) m, supp (mv_add F G) m -> supp F m \/ supp G m.

items.name: supp_basis_only
items.statement: Lemma supp_basis_only : forall n (m0 m : Mask n), supp (basis m0) m -> m = m0.

items.name: supp_mv_one_only_empty
items.statement: Lemma supp_mv_one_only_empty : forall n (m : Mask n), supp (@mv_one n) m -> m = mask_empty.

items.name: supp_bound_noMul
items.statement: Fixpoint supp_bound_noMul {n} (e : GA_expr n) : Mask n -> Prop := match e with | Basis i => fun m => m = mask_single i | Scalar _ => fun m => m = mask_empty | Add e1 e2 => supp_union (supp_bound_noMul e1) (supp_bound_noMul e2) | Conv e1 e2 => supp_xor (supp_bound_noMul e1) (supp_bound_noMul e2) | Mul _ _ => fun _ => True end.

items.name: supp_bound
items.statement: Fixpoint supp_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : Mask n -> Prop := match e with | Basis i => fun m => m = mask_single i | Scalar _ => fun m => m = mask_empty | Add e1 e2 => supp_union (supp_bound e1) (supp_bound e2) | Conv e1 e2 => supp_xor (supp_bound e1) (supp_bound e2) | Mul e1 e2 => match e1, e2 with | Scalar _, _ => supp_bound e2 | _, Scalar _ => supp_bound e1 | _, _ => fun _ => True end end.

items.name: eval_support_within_bound_noMul
items.statement: Theorem eval_support_within_bound_noMul : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) m, supp (eval_expr sq e) m -> supp_bound_noMul e m.

items.name: translate_support_within_bound
items.statement: Corollary translate_support_within_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) m, supp (eval_expr sq (translate phi)) m -> supp_bound_noMul (translate phi) m.

items.name: Qmult_eq_0_l
items.statement: Corollary translate_support_within_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) m, supp (eval_expr sq (translate phi)) m -> supp_bound_noMul (translate phi) m. Proof. intros n sq phi m H. exact (@eval_support_within_bound_noMul n sq (translate phi) m H). Qed. Lemma Qmult_eq_0_l : forall x y : Q, x == 0%Q -> (x * y)%Q == 0%Q.

items.name: Qmult_eq_0_r
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_eq_0_r : forall x y : Q, y == 0%Q -> (x * y)%Q == 0%Q.

items.name: supp_eval_scalar_only_empty
items.statement: Lemma supp_eval_scalar_only_empty : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (c : Q) m, supp (eval_expr sq (Scalar c)) m -> m = mask_empty.

items.name: gp_support_witness
items.statement: Lemma gp_support_witness : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n) (U : Mask n), supp (@mv_gp n sq F G) U -> exists A B, List.In A (all_masks n) /\ List.In B (all_masks n) /\ basis_mul_mask A B = U /\ ~(F A == 0%Q) /\ ~(G B == 0%Q) /\ ~(basis_mul_coeff sq A B == 0%Q).

items.name: supp_gp_scalar_l
items.statement: Lemma supp_gp_scalar_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (c : Q) (G : MV n) U, supp (@mv_gp n sq (eval_expr sq (Scalar c)) G) U -> supp G U.

items.name: supp_gp_scalar_r
items.statement: Lemma supp_gp_scalar_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (c : Q) (F : MV n) U, supp (@mv_gp n sq F (eval_expr sq (Scalar c))) U -> supp F U.

items.name: eval_support_within_bound
items.statement: Theorem eval_support_within_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) m, supp (eval_expr sq e) m -> supp_bound e m.

items.name: translate_support_within_refined_bound
items.statement: Corollary translate_support_within_refined_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) m, supp (eval_expr sq (translate phi)) m -> supp_bound (translate phi) m.

items.name: sumQ_map_le
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_le : forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A), (forall x, In x l -> f x <= g x) -> sumQ (map f l) <= sumQ (map g l).

items.name: l1_norm
items.statement: Definition l1_norm {n} (F : MV n) : Q := sumQ (map (fun U => Qabs (F U)) (all_masks n)).

items.name: Qplus_le_compat_l
items.statement: Lemma Qplus_le_compat_l : forall x y z : Q, y <= z -> x + y <= x + z.

items.name: Qabs_sumQ_le
items.statement: Lemma Qabs_sumQ_le : forall xs : list Q, Qabs (sumQ xs) <= sumQ (map Qabs xs).

items.name: Qabs_sumQ_map_le
items.statement: Lemma Qabs_sumQ_map_le : forall (A:Type) (xs:list A) (f:A->Q), Qabs (sumQ (map f xs)) <= sumQ (map (fun a => Qabs (f a)) xs).

items.name: Qle_of_Qeq
items.statement: Lemma Qle_of_Qeq : forall x y : Q, x == y -> x <= y.

items.name: sumQ_fubini
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_fubini : forall (A B : Type) (la : list A) (lb : list B) (h : A -> B -> Q), sumQ (map (fun a => sumQ (map (fun b => h a b) lb)) la) == sumQ (map (fun b => sumQ (map (fun a => h a b) la)) lb).

items.name: metric_factor_abs1_gen
items.statement: Lemma metric_factor_abs1_gen : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n), (forall i : Fin.t n, Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1) -> forall (A B : Mask n), Qabs (metric_factor sq A B) == 1.

items.name: sumU_xor_delta_conv
items.statement: Lemma sumU_xor_delta_conv : forall n (A B : Mask n), sumQ (map (fun U => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) U then 1%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n)) == 1%Q.

items.name: l1_conv_bound
items.statement: Lemma l1_conv_bound : forall n (F G : MV n), l1_norm (mv_conv F G) <= l1_norm F * l1_norm G.

items.name: metric_factor_abs1
items.statement: Hypothesis sq_unit : forall (i : Fin.t n), Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1. Lemma metric_factor_abs1 : forall (A B : Mask n), Qabs (metric_factor sq A B) == 1.

items.name: basis_mul_coeff_abs1
items.statement: Hypothesis sq_unit : forall (i : Fin.t n), Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1. Lemma metric_factor_abs1 : forall (A B : Mask n), Qabs (metric_factor sq A B) == 1. Proof. exact (metric_factor_abs1_gen sq sq_unit). Qed. Lemma basis_mul_coeff_abs1 : forall (A B : Mask n), Qabs (basis_mul_coeff sq A B) == 1.

items.name: sumU_xor_delta
items.statement: Lemma sumU_xor_delta : forall (A B : Mask n), sumQ (map (fun U => if mask_eq_dec (basis_mul_mask A B) U then 1%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n)) == 1%Q.

items.name: l1_gp_submultiplicative
items.statement: Theorem l1_gp_submultiplicative : forall (F G : MV n), l1_norm (mv_gp sq F G) <= l1_norm F * l1_norm G.

items.name: l1_add_bound
items.statement: Lemma l1_add_bound : forall n (F G : MV n), l1_norm (mv_add F G) <= l1_norm F + l1_norm G.

items.name: l1_gp_bound
items.statement: Lemma l1_gp_bound : forall (F G : MV n), l1_norm (mv_gp sq F G) <= l1_norm F * l1_norm G.

items.name: l1_bound
items.statement: Fixpoint l1_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : Q := match e with | Basis _ => 1 | Scalar c => Qabs c | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 + l1_bound e2 | Cln_Grade.Mul e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 * l1_bound e2 | Cln_Grade.Conv e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 * l1_bound e2 end.

items.name: l1_norm_nonneg
items.statement: Fixpoint l1_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : Q := match e with | Basis _ => 1 | Scalar c => Qabs c | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 + l1_bound e2 | Cln_Grade.Mul e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 * l1_bound e2 | Cln_Grade.Conv e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 * l1_bound e2 end. Lemma l1_norm_nonneg : forall (F : MV n), 0 <= l1_norm F.

items.name: l1_norm_basis
items.statement: Lemma l1_norm_basis : forall (i : Fin.t n), l1_norm (basis (mask_single i)) == 1.

items.name: l1_norm_scale_one
items.statement: Lemma l1_norm_scale_one : forall (c : Q), l1_norm (mv_scale c (@mv_one n)) == Qabs c.

items.name: Qmult_le_compat_nonneg
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_le_compat_nonneg : forall a b c d : Q, 0 <= a -> 0 <= c -> a <= b -> c <= d -> a * c <= b * d.

items.name: l1_norm_eval_le
items.statement: Theorem l1_norm_eval_le : forall (e : GA_expr n), l1_norm (eval_expr sq e) <= l1_bound e.

items.name: Sign
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: Pos
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: Neg
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: Sign_rect
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: Sign_ind
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: Sign_rec
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: Sign_sind
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: sign_eqb
items.statement: Definition sign_eqb (a b : Sign) : bool := match a, b with | Pos, Pos => true | Neg, Neg => true | _, _ => false end.

items.name: sign_eqb_refl
items.statement: Definition sign_eqb (a b : Sign) : bool := match a, b with | Pos, Pos => true | Neg, Neg => true | _, _ => false end. Lemma sign_eqb_refl : forall s, sign_eqb s s = true.

items.name: sign_eqb_eq
items.statement: Definition sign_eqb (a b : Sign) : bool := match a, b with | Pos, Pos => true | Neg, Neg => true | _, _ => false end. Lemma sign_eqb_refl : forall s, sign_eqb s s = true. Proof. destruct s; reflexivity. Qed. Lemma sign_eqb_eq : forall a b, sign_eqb a b = true -> a = b.

items.name: sign_eq_dec
items.statement: Lemma sign_eq_dec : forall (a b : Sign), {a = b} + {a <> b}.

items.name: Corner
items.statement: Definition Corner (n : nat) : Type := Vector.t Sign n.

items.name: Mask
items.statement: Definition Mask (n : nat) : Type := Vector.t bool n.

items.name: corner0
items.statement: Definition corner0 : Corner 0 := Vector.nil Sign.

items.name: corner_eq_dec
items.statement: Definition corner0 : Corner 0 := Vector.nil Sign. (* Decidable equality on vectors (Corners and Masks) *) Fixpoint corner_eq_dec {n : nat} (x y : Corner n) : {x = y} + {x <> y}.

items.name: mask_eq_dec
items.statement: Fixpoint mask_eq_dec {n : nat} (x y : Mask n) : {x = y} + {x <> y}.

items.name: corner_eqb
items.statement: Fixpoint corner_eqb {n} : Corner n -> Corner n -> bool := match n with | 0 => fun _ _ => true | S n' => fun a b => andb (sign_eqb (Vector.hd a) (Vector.hd b)) (corner_eqb (Vector.tl a) (Vector.tl b)) end.

items.name: corner_eqb_refl
items.statement: Fixpoint corner_eqb {n} : Corner n -> Corner n -> bool := match n with | 0 => fun _ _ => true | S n' => fun a b => andb (sign_eqb (Vector.hd a) (Vector.hd b)) (corner_eqb (Vector.tl a) (Vector.tl b)) end. Lemma corner_eqb_refl : forall n (c : Corner n), corner_eqb c c = true.

items.name: corner_eqb_eq
items.statement: Lemma corner_eqb_eq : forall n (a b : Corner n), corner_eqb a b = true -> a = b.

items.name: all_masks
items.statement: Fixpoint all_masks (n : nat) : list (Mask n) := match n with | 0 => [ Vector.nil bool ] | S n' => let ms := all_masks n' in (List.map (fun m => false :: m) ms) ++ (List.map (fun m => true :: m) ms) end.

items.name: all_corners
items.statement: Fixpoint all_corners (n : nat) : list (Corner n) := match n with | 0 => [ Vector.nil Sign ] | S n' => let cs := all_corners n' in (List.map (fun c => Pos :: c) cs) ++ (List.map (fun c => Neg :: c) cs) end.

items.name: in_map_iff'
items.statement: Lemma in_map_iff' : forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (x : B) (l : list A), List.In x (List.map f l) <-> exists y, List.In y l /\ f y = x.

items.name: cons_inj_sign
items.statement: Lemma cons_inj_sign : forall n (s1 s2 : Sign) (t1 t2 : Corner n), (s1 :: t1 = s2 :: t2) -> s1 = s2 /\ t1 = t2.

items.name: cons_inj_bool
items.statement: Lemma cons_inj_bool : forall n (b1 b2 : bool) (t1 t2 : Mask n), (b1 :: t1 = b2 :: t2) -> b1 = b2 /\ t1 = t2.

items.name: NoDup_map_inj
items.statement: Lemma NoDup_map_inj : forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (l : list A), (forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y) -> List.NoDup l -> List.NoDup (List.map f l).

items.name: all_masks_complete
items.statement: Lemma all_masks_complete : forall n (m : Mask n), List.In m (all_masks n).

items.name: all_masks_nodup
items.statement: Lemma all_masks_nodup : forall n, List.NoDup (all_masks n).

items.name: all_corners_complete
items.statement: Lemma all_corners_complete : forall n (c : Corner n), List.In c (all_corners n).

items.name: all_corners_nodup
items.statement: Lemma all_corners_nodup : forall n, List.NoDup (all_corners n).

items.name: MV
items.statement: Definition MV (n : nat) : Type := Mask n -> Q.

items.name: mv_zero
items.statement: Definition mv_zero {n} : MV n := fun _ => 0%Q.

items.name: mv_add
items.statement: Definition mv_add {n} (F G : MV n) : MV n := fun m => (F m + G m)%Q.

items.name: mv_scale
items.statement: Definition mv_scale {n} (k : Q) (F : MV n) : MV n := fun m => (k * F m)%Q.

items.name: mv_neg
items.statement: Definition mv_neg {n} (F : MV n) : MV n := mv_scale (-1)%Q F.

items.name: mv_sub
items.statement: Definition mv_sub {n} (F G : MV n) : MV n := fun m => (F m - G m)%Q.

items.name: basis
items.statement: Definition basis {n} (S : Mask n) : MV n := fun T => if mask_eq_dec T S then 1%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: sumQ
items.statement: Fixpoint sumQ (xs : list Q) : Q := match xs with | List.nil => 0%Q | List.cons x tl => (x + sumQ tl)%Q end.

items.name: sumQ_app
items.statement: Fixpoint sumQ (xs : list Q) : Q := match xs with | List.nil => 0%Q | List.cons x tl => (x + sumQ tl)%Q end. Lemma sumQ_app : forall xs ys, sumQ (xs ++ ys) == (sumQ xs + sumQ ys)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_const0
items.statement: Fixpoint sumQ (xs : list Q) : Q := match xs with | List.nil => 0%Q | List.cons x tl => (x + sumQ tl)%Q end. Lemma sumQ_app : forall xs ys, sumQ (xs ++ ys) == (sumQ xs + sumQ ys)%Q. Proof. induction xs; intros ys; simpl. - ring. - rewrite IHxs. ring. Qed. Lemma sumQ_map_const0 : forall (A : Type) (l : list A), sumQ (List.map (fun _ : A => 0%Q) l) == 0%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_ext
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_ext : forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A), (forall x, List.In x l -> f x == g x) -> sumQ (List.map f l) == sumQ (List.map g l).

items.name: sumQ_map_add
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_add : forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A), sumQ (List.map (fun x => (f x + g x)%Q) l) == (sumQ (List.map f l) + sumQ (List.map g l))%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_scale_l
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_scale_l : forall (A : Type) (k : Q) (f : A -> Q) (l : list A), sumQ (List.map (fun x => (k * f x)%Q) l) == (k * sumQ (List.map f l))%Q.

items.name: sQ
items.statement: Definition sQ (s : Sign) : Q := match s with | Pos => 1%Q | Neg => (-1)%Q end.

items.name: sQ_sq1
items.statement: Definition sQ (s : Sign) : Q := match s with | Pos => 1%Q | Neg => (-1)%Q end. Lemma sQ_sq1 : forall s, (sQ s * sQ s)%Q == 1%Q.

items.name: sQ_mul_eqb
items.statement: Definition sQ (s : Sign) : Q := match s with | Pos => 1%Q | Neg => (-1)%Q end. Lemma sQ_sq1 : forall s, (sQ s * sQ s)%Q == 1%Q. Proof. destruct s; simpl; ring. Qed. Lemma sQ_mul_eqb : forall a b, (sQ a * sQ b)%Q == (if sign_eqb a b then 1%Q else (-1)%Q).

items.name: chi
items.statement: Fixpoint chi (n : nat) : Mask n -> Corner n -> Q := match n with | O => fun _ _ => 1%Q | S n' => fun m s => let mh := Vector.hd m in let mt := Vector.tl m in let sh := Vector.hd s in let st := Vector.tl s in ((if mh then sQ sh else 1%Q) * (@chi n' mt st))%Q end.

items.name: chi'
items.statement: Definition chi' {n : nat} : Mask n -> Corner n -> Q := @chi n.

items.name: chi_false_cons
items.statement: Definition chi' {n : nat} : Mask n -> Corner n -> Q := @chi n. Lemma chi_false_cons : forall n (m : Mask n) (s : Corner n) (h : Sign), chi' (n := S n) (Vector.cons bool false n m) (Vector.cons Sign h n s) == chi' (n := n) m s.

items.name: chi_true_cons
items.statement: Lemma chi_true_cons : forall n (m : Mask n) (s : Corner n) (h : Sign), chi' (n := S n) (Vector.cons bool true n m) (Vector.cons Sign h n s) == (sQ h * chi' (n := n) m s)%Q.

items.name: pow2
items.statement: Fixpoint pow2 (n : nat) : Q := match n with | O => 1%Q | S k => (2%Q * pow2 k)%Q end.

items.name: pow2_nonzero
items.statement: Fixpoint pow2 (n : nat) : Q := match n with | O => 1%Q | S k => (2%Q * pow2 k)%Q end. Lemma pow2_nonzero : forall n, ~(pow2 n == 0%Q).

items.name: eval
items.statement: Definition eval {n} (F : MV n) (s : Corner n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun m => (F m * chi' m s)%Q) (all_masks n)).

items.name: eval_add
items.statement: Definition eval {n} (F : MV n) (s : Corner n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun m => (F m * chi' m s)%Q) (all_masks n)). Lemma eval_add : forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n), eval (mv_add F G) s == (eval F s + eval G s)%Q.

items.name: eval_scale
items.statement: Lemma eval_scale : forall n (k : Q) (F : MV n) (s : Corner n), eval (mv_scale k F) s == (k * eval F s)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_zero
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_zero : forall (A : Type) (l : list A), sumQ (List.map (fun _ => 0%Q) l) == 0%Q.

items.name: eval_sum_over_corners
items.statement: Lemma eval_sum_over_corners : forall n (cs : list (Corner n)) (H : Corner n -> MV n) (s : Corner n), eval (fun m => sumQ (List.map (fun a => H a m) cs)) s == sumQ (List.map (fun a => eval (H a) s) cs).

items.name: map_map
items.statement: Lemma map_map : forall (A B C : Type) (f : B -> C) (g : A -> B) (l : list A), List.map f (List.map g l) = List.map (fun x => f (g x)) l.

items.name: Qadd_factor_r
items.statement: Lemma Qadd_factor_r : forall x k : Q, x + k * x == (1 + k) * x.

items.name: Qmul_assoc3
items.statement: Lemma Qmul_assoc3 : forall a b c : Q, (a * b) * c == a * (b * c).

items.name: bQ
items.statement: Definition bQ (b : bool) : Q := if b then 1%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: Pi
items.statement: Definition Pi {n} (a : Corner n) : MV n := fun m => ((1%Q / pow2 n) * chi m a)%Q.

items.name: walsh_sum_masks
items.statement: Definition walsh_sum_masks {n} (a s : Corner n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun m : Mask n => (chi' m a * chi' m s)%Q) (all_masks n)).

items.name: walsh_sum_masks_0
items.statement: Definition walsh_sum_masks {n} (a s : Corner n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun m : Mask n => (chi' m a * chi' m s)%Q) (all_masks n)). Lemma walsh_sum_masks_0 : forall (a s : Corner 0), walsh_sum_masks a s == 1%Q.

items.name: walsh_sum_masks_S
items.statement: Lemma walsh_sum_masks_S : forall n (a s : Corner (S n)), walsh_sum_masks a s == ((1%Q + (sQ (Vector.hd a) * sQ (Vector.hd s))%Q) * walsh_sum_masks (Vector.tl a) (Vector.tl s))%Q.

items.name: walsh_sum_masks_closed
items.statement: Lemma walsh_sum_masks_closed : forall n (a s : Corner n), walsh_sum_masks a s == (if corner_eqb a s then pow2 n else 0%Q).

items.name: Pi_delta
items.statement: Lemma Pi_delta : forall n (a s : Corner n), eval (Pi a) s == (if corner_eqb a s then 1%Q else 0%Q).

items.name: embed
items.statement: Definition embed {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) : MV n := fun m => sumQ (List.map (fun a => (bQ (f a) * Pi a m)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: embed_correct
items.statement: Definition embed {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) : MV n := fun m => sumQ (List.map (fun a => (bQ (f a) * Pi a m)%Q) (all_corners n)). Theorem embed_correct : forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (s : Corner n), eval (embed f) s == bQ (f s).

items.name: mask_xor
items.statement: Definition mask_xor {n} (a b : Mask n) : Mask n := Vector.map2 xorb a b.

items.name: mask_and
items.statement: Definition mask_and {n} (a b : Mask n) : Mask n := Vector.map2 andb a b.

items.name: mask_empty
items.statement: Definition mask_empty {n} : Mask n := Vector.const false n.

items.name: grade_parity
items.statement: Definition grade_parity {n} (m : Mask n) : bool := List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list m).

items.name: mv_conv
items.statement: Definition mv_conv {n : nat} (F G : MV n) : MV n := fun U => sumQ (List.map (fun A => sumQ (List.map (fun B => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) U then (F A * G B)%Q else 0%Q ) (all_masks n)) ) (all_masks n)).

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick
items.statement: Definition mv_conv {n : nat} (F G : MV n) : MV n := fun U => sumQ (List.map (fun A => sumQ (List.map (fun B => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) U then (F A * G B)%Q else 0%Q ) (all_masks n)) ) (all_masks n)). Local Opaque mask_eq_dec. Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick : forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (U : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun m => if mask_eq_dec m U then f m else 0%Q) (all_masks n)) == f U.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_eq
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_eq : forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (U : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun X => if mask_eq_dec X U then f X else 0%Q) (all_masks n)) == f U.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_eq_xor
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_eq_xor : forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (A B : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun X => if mask_eq_dec X (mask_xor A B) then f X else 0%Q) (all_masks n)) == f (mask_xor A B).

items.name: chi_mul
items.statement: Lemma chi_mul : forall n (A B : Mask n) (s : Corner n), (chi' A s * chi' B s)%Q == chi' (mask_xor A B) s.

items.name: eval_sum_over_list
items.statement: Lemma eval_sum_over_list : forall n (A : Type) (xs : list A) (H : A -> MV n) (s : Corner n), eval (fun m : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun a => H a m) xs)) s == sumQ (List.map (fun a => eval (H a) s) xs).

items.name: swaps_parity
items.statement: Definition swaps_parity {n} (a b : Mask n) : bool := fst (List.fold_right (fun ab st => let '(ai, bi) := ab in let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p)) (false, false) (List.combine (Vector.to_list a) (Vector.to_list b))).

items.name: sgnQ
items.statement: Definition sgnQ (b : bool) : Q := if b then (-1)%Q else 1%Q.

items.name: metric_factor
items.statement: Definition metric_factor {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (a b : Mask n) : Q := List.fold_right Qmult 1%Q (List.map (fun '(sq_i, ab) => let '(ai, bi) := ab in if andb ai bi then sq_i else 1%Q) (List.combine (Vector.to_list sq) (List.combine (Vector.to_list a) (Vector.to_list b)))).

items.name: basis_mul_coeff
items.statement: Definition basis_mul_coeff {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A B : Mask n) : Q := (sgnQ (swaps_parity A B) * metric_factor sq A B)%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_mask
items.statement: Definition basis_mul_mask {n} (A B : Mask n) : Mask n := mask_xor A B.

items.name: mv_gp
items.statement: Definition mv_gp (n : nat) (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n) : MV n := fun U => sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n => let c := basis_mul_coeff sq A B in if mask_eq_dec (basis_mul_mask A B) U then (F A * G B * c)%Q else 0%Q ) (all_masks n)) ) (all_masks n)).

items.name: mv_one
items.statement: Definition mv_one {n} : MV n := basis (mask_empty (n:=n)).

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_r_eq
items.statement: FunctionalExtensionality. Require Import QArith. Require Import Qcanon. Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_eq : forall x y z : Q, (x + y) * z == x * z + y * z.

items.name: Qmult_assoc_eq
items.statement: FunctionalExtensionality. Require Import QArith. Require Import Qcanon. Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_eq : forall x y z : Q, (x + y) * z == x * z + y * z. Proof. intros. ring. Qed. Lemma Qmult_assoc_eq : forall x y z : Q, (x * y) * z == x * (y * z).

items.name: mv_gp_add_l
items.statement: FunctionalExtensionality. Require Import QArith. Require Import Qcanon. Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_eq : forall x y z : Q, (x + y) * z == x * z + y * z. Proof. intros. ring. Qed. Lemma Qmult_assoc_eq : forall x y z : Q, (x * y) * z == x * (y * z). Proof. intros. ring. Qed. Lemma mv_gp_add_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F1 F2 G : MV n) (U : Mask n), @mv_gp n sq (mv_add F1 F2) G U == mv_add (@mv_gp n sq F1 G) (@mv_gp n sq F2 G) U.

items.name: mv_gp_add_r
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_add_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G1 G2 : MV n) (U : Mask n), @mv_gp n sq F (mv_add G1 G2) U == mv_add (@mv_gp n sq F G1) (@mv_gp n sq F G2) U.

items.name: mv_gp_scale_l
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_scale_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (k : Q) (F G : MV n) (U : Mask n), @mv_gp n sq (mv_scale k F) G U == mv_scale k (@mv_gp n sq F G) U.

items.name: mv_gp_scale_r
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_scale_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (k : Q) (F G : MV n) (U : Mask n), @mv_gp n sq F (mv_scale k G) U == mv_scale k (@mv_gp n sq F G) U.

items.name: mask_xor_empty_l
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_empty_l : forall n (B : Mask n), mask_xor (mask_empty (n:=n)) B = B.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_l_aux
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_empty_l_aux : forall n (B : Mask n), List.fold_right (fun ab st => let '(ai, bi) := ab in let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p)) (false, false) (List.combine (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)) (Vector.to_list B)) = (false, false).

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_l
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_empty_l : forall n (B : Mask n), swaps_parity (Vector.const false n) B = false.

items.name: metric_factor_empty_l
items.statement: Lemma metric_factor_empty_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (B : Mask n), metric_factor sq (mask_empty (n:=n)) B == 1%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_coeff_empty_l
items.statement: Lemma basis_mul_coeff_empty_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (B : Mask n), basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_empty (n:=n)) B == 1%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_one_l
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_one_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F : MV n) (U : Mask n), @mv_gp n sq mv_one F U == F U.

items.name: mask_xor_empty_r
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_empty_r : forall n (A : Mask n), mask_xor A (mask_empty (n:=n)) = A.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_fst
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_fst : forall n (A : Mask n), fst (List.fold_right (fun ab st => let '(ai, bi) := ab in let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p)) (false, false) (List.combine (Vector.to_list A) (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)))) = false.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_r
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_empty_r : forall n (A : Mask n), swaps_parity A (Vector.const false n) = false.

items.name: metric_factor_empty_r
items.statement: Lemma metric_factor_empty_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A : Mask n), metric_factor sq A (mask_empty (n:=n)) == 1%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_coeff_empty_r
items.statement: Lemma basis_mul_coeff_empty_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A : Mask n), basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_empty (n:=n)) == 1%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_one_r
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_one_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F : MV n) (U : Mask n), @mv_gp n sq F (@mv_one n) U == F U.

items.name: mv_gp_basis
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_basis : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A B : Mask n) (U : Mask n), @mv_gp n sq (basis A) (basis B) U == (if mask_eq_dec U (basis_mul_mask A B) then basis_mul_coeff sq A B else 0%Q).

items.name: mask_single
items.statement: Fixpoint mask_single {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : Mask n := match i with | Fin.F1 => true :: Vector.const false _ | Fin.FS j => false :: mask_single j end.

items.name: e
items.statement: Definition e (n : nat) (i : Fin.t n) : MV n := basis (mask_single i).

items.name: mask_xor_self
items.statement: Definition e (n : nat) (i : Fin.t n) : MV n := basis (mask_single i). (* ============================================================ *) (* Clifford relations on generators *) (* ============================================================ *) Lemma mask_xor_self : forall n (A : Mask n), mask_xor A A = mask_empty (n:=n).

items.name: mask_xor_comm
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_comm : forall n (A B : Mask n), mask_xor A B = mask_xor B A.

items.name: metric_factor_single_square
items.statement: Lemma metric_factor_single_square : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i : Fin.t n), metric_factor sq (mask_single i) (mask_single i) == Vector.nth sq i.

items.name: swaps_parity_const_false
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_const_false : forall n, swaps_parity (Vector.const false n) (Vector.const false n) = false.

items.name: swaps_state_const_false
items.statement: Lemma swaps_state_const_false : forall n, List.fold_right (fun ab st : bool * bool => let '(ai, bi) := ab in let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (bi && p), xorb ai p)) (false, false) (List.combine (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)) (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n))) = (false, false).

items.name: swaps_parity_single_self
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_single_self : forall n (i : Fin.t n), swaps_parity (mask_single i) (mask_single i) = false.

items.name: e_square
items.statement: Lemma e_square : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i : Fin.t n) (U : Mask n), (@mv_gp n sq (e i) (e i)) U == (mv_scale (Vector.nth sq i) mv_one) U.

items.name: metric_factor_single_disjoint
items.statement: Lemma metric_factor_single_disjoint : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i j : Fin.t n), i <> j -> metric_factor sq (mask_single i) (mask_single j) == 1%Q.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_snd
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_snd : forall n (A : Mask n), snd (List.fold_right (fun ab st => let '(ai, bi) := ab in let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p)) (false, false) (List.combine (Vector.to_list A) (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)))) = List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list A).

items.name: parity_const_false
items.statement: Lemma parity_const_false : forall n, List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)) = false.

items.name: to_list_cons
items.statement: Lemma to_list_cons : forall (A : Type) n (a : A) (v : Vector.t A n), Vector.to_list (Vector.cons A a n v) = (a :: Vector.to_list v)%list.

items.name: mask_single_FS
items.statement: Lemma mask_single_FS : forall n (j : Fin.t n), mask_single (Fin.FS j) = Vector.cons bool false n (mask_single j).

items.name: parity_mask_single_true
items.statement: Lemma parity_mask_single_true : forall n (j : Fin.t n), List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list (mask_single j)) = true.

items.name: fst_let_pair
items.statement: Lemma fst_let_pair : forall (t : bool * bool), fst (let '(s,p) := t in (xorb s false, p)) = fst t.

items.name: swaps_parity_single_swap_negb
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_single_swap_negb : forall n (i j : Fin.t n), i <> j -> swaps_parity (mask_single i) (mask_single j) = negb (swaps_parity (mask_single j) (mask_single i)).

items.name: sgnQ_swaps_parity_flip
items.statement: Lemma sgnQ_swaps_parity_flip : forall n (i j : Fin.t n), i <> j -> sgnQ (swaps_parity (mask_single i) (mask_single j)) == (-1)%Q * sgnQ (swaps_parity (mask_single j) (mask_single i)).

items.name: e_anticomm
items.statement: Lemma e_anticomm : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i j : Fin.t n) (U : Mask n), i <> j -> (@mv_gp n sq (e i) (e j)) U == mv_scale (-1)%Q (@mv_gp n sq (e j) (e i)) U.

items.name: sgnQ_xorb
items.statement: Lemma sgnQ_xorb : forall b1 b2, (sgnQ b1 * sgnQ b2)%Q == sgnQ (xorb b1 b2).

items.name: sgnQ_negb
items.statement: Lemma sgnQ_negb : forall b, sgnQ (negb b) == (-1)%Q * sgnQ b.

items.name: sumQ_fubini
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_fubini : forall (A B : Type) (la : list A) (lb : list B) (h : A -> B -> Q), sumQ (List.map (fun a => sumQ (List.map (fun b => h a b) lb)) la) == sumQ (List.map (fun b => sumQ (List.map (fun a => h a b) la)) lb).

items.name: parity_mask
items.statement: Definition parity_mask {n} (A : Mask n) : bool := List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list A).

items.name: parity_mask_cons
items.statement: Definition parity_mask {n} (A : Mask n) : bool := List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list A). Lemma parity_mask_cons : forall n (h:bool) (A:Mask n), parity_mask (h :: A) = xorb h (parity_mask A).

items.name: map2_cons
items.statement: Lemma map2_cons : forall (A B C : Type) (g : A -> B -> C) n (a : A) (b : B) (va : Vector.t A n) (vb : Vector.t B n), Vector.map2 g (a :: va) (b :: vb) = (g a b) :: Vector.map2 g va vb.

items.name: mask_xor_cons
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_cons : forall n (a b : bool) (A B : Mask n), mask_xor (a :: A) (b :: B) = (xorb a b) :: mask_xor A B.

items.name: xorb_assoc
items.statement: Lemma xorb_assoc : forall a b c, xorb a (xorb b c) = xorb (xorb a b) c.

items.name: xorb_comm
items.statement: Lemma xorb_comm : forall a b, xorb a b = xorb b a.

items.name: parity_mask_xor
items.statement: Lemma parity_mask_xor : forall n (A B : Mask n), parity_mask (mask_xor A B) = xorb (parity_mask A) (parity_mask B).

items.name: swaps_state_snd
items.statement: Lemma swaps_state_snd : forall n (A B : Mask n), snd (List.fold_right (fun ab st : bool * bool => let '(ai, bi) := ab in let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (bi && p), xorb ai p)) (false, false) (List.combine (Vector.to_list A) (Vector.to_list B))) = parity_mask A.

items.name: swaps_parity_cons
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_cons : forall n (a b : bool) (A B : Mask n), swaps_parity (Vector.cons _ a _ A) (Vector.cons _ b _ B) = xorb (swaps_parity A B) (b && parity_mask A).

items.name: swaps_parity_cocycle
items.statement: Lemma swaps_parity_cocycle : forall n (A B C : Mask n), xorb (swaps_parity A B) (swaps_parity (mask_xor A B) C) = xorb (swaps_parity B C) (swaps_parity A (mask_xor B C)).

items.name: metric_factor_cons
items.statement: Lemma metric_factor_cons : forall n (h : Q) (sq : Vector.t Q n) (a b : bool) (A B : Mask n), metric_factor (Vector.cons Q h n sq) (Vector.cons bool a n A) (Vector.cons bool b n B) == (if andb a b then h else 1%Q) * metric_factor sq A B.

items.name: metric_factor_cocycle
items.statement: Lemma metric_factor_cocycle : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A B C : Mask n), (metric_factor sq A B * metric_factor sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q == (metric_factor sq B C * metric_factor sq A (mask_xor B C))%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_assoc_coeff
items.statement: Lemma basis_mul_assoc_coeff : forall n sq (A B C : Mask n), (basis_mul_coeff sq A B * basis_mul_coeff sq (basis_mul_mask A B) C)%Q == (basis_mul_coeff sq B C * basis_mul_coeff sq A (basis_mul_mask B C))%Q.

items.name: mask0_eta
items.statement: Lemma mask0_eta : forall (C : Mask 0), C = [].

items.name: mask_xor_assoc
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_assoc : forall n (A B C : Mask n), mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C = mask_xor A (mask_xor B C).

items.name: mask_xor_cancel_l
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_cancel_l : forall n (X Y : Mask n), mask_xor X Y = X -> Y = mask_empty (n:=n).

items.name: if_mask_eq_dec_sym
items.statement: Lemma if_mask_eq_dec_sym : forall n (X Y : Mask n) (a b : Q), (if mask_eq_dec X Y then a else b) == (if mask_eq_dec Y X then a else b).

items.name: mv_gp_triple
items.statement: Definition mv_gp_triple (n : nat) (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun A => sumQ (List.map (fun B => sumQ (List.map (fun C => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C) U then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq A B * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: sumQ_map_scale_r
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_scale_r : forall (A : Type) (k : Q) (f : A -> Q) (xs : list A), sumQ (List.map (fun x => (f x * k)%Q) xs) == (sumQ (List.map f xs) * k)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_push_const
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_push_const : forall (A : Type) (xs : list A) (k : Q) (f : A -> Q), sumQ (List.map (fun x => (k * f x)%Q) xs) == (k * sumQ (List.map f xs))%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n), mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U == sumQ (List.map (fun X : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun C : Mask n => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X C) U then (sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) X then (F A * G B * basis_mul_coeff sq A B)%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)) * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq X C)%Q else 0%Q ) (all_masks n)) ) (all_masks n)).

items.name: K_LHS
items.statement: Definition K_LHS {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n) (X C A B : Mask n) : Q := if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X C) U then if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) X then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq A B * basis_mul_coeff sq X C)%Q else 0%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad_kernel
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad_kernel : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n), mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U == sumQ (List.map (fun X : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun C : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n => K_LHS sq F G H U X C A B) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: if_mask_eq_dec_flip
items.statement: Lemma if_mask_eq_dec_flip : forall n (X Y : Mask n) (t e : Q), (if mask_eq_dec X Y then t else e) == (if mask_eq_dec Y X then t else e).

items.name: sumQ_fubini_masks
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_fubini_masks (n : nat) (h : Mask n -> Mask n -> Q) : sumQ (List.map (fun x => sumQ (List.map (h x) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)) == sumQ (List.map (fun y => sumQ (List.map (fun x => h x y) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: sumQ_fubini_masks_in
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_fubini_masks_in (n : nat) (L : list (Mask n)) (h : Mask n -> Mask n -> Mask n -> Q) : sumQ (List.map (fun x => sumQ (List.map (fun a => sumQ (List.map (fun b => h x a b) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) L) == sumQ (List.map (fun x => sumQ (List.map (fun b => sumQ (List.map (fun a => h x a b) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) L).

items.name: K_LHS_X_collapse
items.statement: Lemma K_LHS_X_collapse : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U C A B : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun X => K_LHS sq F G H U X C A B) (all_masks n)) == if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C) U then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq A B * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: K_RHS
items.statement: Definition K_RHS {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n) (A Y B C : Mask n) : Q := if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A Y) U then if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor B C) Y then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq B C * basis_mul_coeff sq A Y)%Q else 0%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_RHS_quad_kernel
items.statement: Definition K_RHS {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n) (A Y B C : Mask n) : Q := if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A Y) U then if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor B C) Y then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq B C * basis_mul_coeff sq A Y)%Q else 0%Q else 0%Q. Lemma mv_gp_assoc_RHS_quad_kernel : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n), mv_gp sq F (mv_gp sq G H) U == sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun Y : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun C : Mask n => K_RHS sq F G H U A Y B C) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: K_RHS_Y_collapse
items.statement: Lemma K_RHS_Y_collapse : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U A B C : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun Y => K_RHS sq F G H U A Y B C) (all_masks n)) == if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A (mask_xor B C)) U then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq B C * basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_xor B C))%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: K_LHS_B_collapse
items.statement: Lemma K_LHS_B_collapse : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U X C A : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun B => K_LHS sq F G H U X C A B) (all_masks n)) == if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X C) U then (F A * G (mask_xor A X) * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_xor A X) * basis_mul_coeff sq X C)%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: K_LHS_CAB
items.statement: Definition K_LHS_CAB {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n) (X C A B : Mask n) : Q := if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X B) U then if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor C A) X then (F C * G A * H B * basis_mul_coeff sq C A * basis_mul_coeff sq X B)%Q else 0%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: K_LHS_X_collapse_CAB
items.statement: Lemma K_LHS_X_collapse_CAB : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U A B C : Mask n), sumQ (List.map (fun X => K_LHS sq F G H U X A B C) (all_masks n)) == if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor B C) A) U then (F B * G C * H A * basis_mul_coeff sq B C * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor B C) A)%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_RHS_triple
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_assoc_RHS_triple : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n), mv_gp sq F (mv_gp sq G H) U == sumQ (List.map (fun A => sumQ (List.map (fun B => sumQ (List.map (fun C => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A (mask_xor B C)) U then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq B C * basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_xor B C))%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_LHS_triple
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_assoc_LHS_triple : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n), mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U == sumQ (List.map (fun A => sumQ (List.map (fun B => sumQ (List.map (fun C => if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C) U then (F A * G B * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq A B * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: mv_gp_assoc
items.statement: Lemma mv_gp_assoc : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n), mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U == mv_gp sq F (mv_gp sq G H) U.

items.name: eval_conv
items.statement: Lemma eval_conv : forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n), eval (mv_conv F G) s == (eval F s * eval G s)%Q.

items.name: grade
items.statement: Definition grade {n} (m : Mask n) : nat := List.count_occ Bool.bool_dec (Vector.to_list m) true.

items.name: grade_cons_true
items.statement: Definition grade {n} (m : Mask n) : nat := List.count_occ Bool.bool_dec (Vector.to_list m) true. Lemma grade_cons_true : forall n (m : Mask n), grade (Vector.cons _ true _ m) = S (grade m).

items.name: grade_cons_false
items.statement: Lemma grade_cons_false : forall n (m : Mask n), grade (Vector.cons _ false _ m) = grade m.

items.name: grade_empty_mask
items.statement: Lemma grade_empty_mask : forall n, grade (mask_empty (n:=n)) = 0%nat.

items.name: grade_full_mask
items.statement: Lemma grade_full_mask : forall n, grade (Vector.const true n) = n.

items.name: grade_single
items.statement: Lemma grade_single : forall n (i : Fin.t n), grade (mask_single i) = 1%nat.

items.name: grade_le_n
items.statement: Lemma grade_le_n : forall n (m : Mask n), (grade m <= n)%nat.

items.name: grade_xor_le
items.statement: Lemma grade_xor_le : forall n (A B : Mask n), (grade (mask_xor A B) <= grade A + grade B)%nat.

items.name: grade_basis_mul_mask_le
items.statement: Lemma grade_basis_mul_mask_le : forall n (A B : Mask n), (grade (basis_mul_mask A B) <= grade A + grade B)%nat.

items.name: Qeq_bool_false_neq
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_bool_false_neq : forall x y : Q, Qeq_bool x y = false -> ~(x == y).

items.name: Qeq_dec
items.statement: Definition Qeq_dec (x y : Q) : {x == y} + {~(x == y)}.

items.name: max_grade
items.statement: Definition max_grade {n} (F : MV n) : nat := List.fold_right Nat.max 0%nat (List.map (fun m => if Qeq_bool (F m) 0 then 0%nat else grade m) (all_masks n)).

items.name: fold_max_ge_In
items.statement: Definition max_grade {n} (F : MV n) : nat := List.fold_right Nat.max 0%nat (List.map (fun m => if Qeq_bool (F m) 0 then 0%nat else grade m) (all_masks n)). (* --- Helpers for fold_right Nat.max --- *) Lemma fold_max_ge_In : forall (l : list nat) (x : nat), List.In x l -> (x <= List.fold_right Nat.max 0%nat l)%nat.

items.name: fold_max_le_bound
items.statement: Lemma fold_max_le_bound : forall (l : list nat) (k : nat), (forall x, List.In x l -> (x <= k)%nat) -> (List.fold_right Nat.max 0%nat l <= k)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_spec
items.statement: Lemma max_grade_spec : forall n (F : MV n) (m : Mask n), ~(F m == 0) -> (grade m <= max_grade F)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_le_n
items.statement: Lemma max_grade_le_n : forall n (F : MV n), (max_grade F <= n)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded
items.statement: Definition grade_bounded {n} (F : MV n) (k : nat) : Prop := forall m : Mask n, (grade m > k)%nat -> F m == 0.

items.name: max_grade_bounded
items.statement: Definition grade_bounded {n} (F : MV n) (k : nat) : Prop := forall m : Mask n, (grade m > k)%nat -> F m == 0. Lemma max_grade_bounded : forall n (F : MV n), grade_bounded F (max_grade F).

items.name: bounded_implies_max_grade_le
items.statement: Lemma bounded_implies_max_grade_le : forall n (F : MV n) (k : nat), grade_bounded F k -> (max_grade F <= k)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_mono
items.statement: Lemma grade_bounded_mono : forall n (F : MV n) (j k : nat), grade_bounded F j -> (j <= k)%nat -> grade_bounded F k.

items.name: grade_bounded_zero
items.statement: Lemma grade_bounded_zero : forall n (k : nat), grade_bounded (@mv_zero n) k.

items.name: grade_bounded_add
items.statement: Lemma grade_bounded_add : forall n (F G : MV n) (j k : nat), grade_bounded F j -> grade_bounded G k -> grade_bounded (mv_add F G) (Nat.max j k).

items.name: max_grade_add_le
items.statement: Lemma max_grade_add_le : forall n (F G : MV n), (max_grade (mv_add F G) <= Nat.max (max_grade F) (max_grade G))%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_gp
items.statement: Lemma grade_bounded_gp : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n) (j k : nat), grade_bounded F j -> grade_bounded G k -> grade_bounded (mv_gp sq F G) (j + k)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_gp_le
items.statement: Lemma max_grade_gp_le : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n), (max_grade (mv_gp sq F G) <= max_grade F + max_grade G)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_conv
items.statement: Lemma grade_bounded_conv : forall n (F G : MV n) (j k : nat), grade_bounded F j -> grade_bounded G k -> grade_bounded (mv_conv F G) (j + k)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_conv_le
items.statement: Lemma max_grade_conv_le : forall n (F G : MV n), (max_grade (mv_conv F G) <= max_grade F + max_grade G)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_basis_single
items.statement: Lemma grade_bounded_basis_single : forall n (i : Fin.t n), grade_bounded (basis (mask_single i)) 1%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_scale_one
items.statement: Lemma grade_bounded_scale_one : forall n (c : Q), grade_bounded (mv_scale c (@mv_one n)) 0%nat.

items.name: GA_expr
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: Basis
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: Scalar
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: Add
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: Mul
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: Conv
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: GA_expr_rect
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: GA_expr_ind
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: GA_expr_rec
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: GA_expr_sind
items.statement: Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type := | Basis : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n | Add : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n | Mul : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n (* geometric product *) | Conv : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: eval_expr
items.statement: Fixpoint eval_expr {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) : MV n := match e with | Basis i => basis (mask_single i) | Scalar c => mv_scale c mv_one | Add e1 e2 => mv_add (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2) | Mul e1 e2 => mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2) | Conv e1 e2 => mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2) end.

items.name: grade_bound
items.statement: Fixpoint grade_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat := match e with | Basis _ => 1%nat | Scalar _ => 0%nat | Add e1 e2 => Nat.max (grade_bound e1) (grade_bound e2) | Mul e1 e2 => (grade_bound e1 + grade_bound e2)%nat | Conv e1 e2 => (grade_bound e1 + grade_bound e2)%nat end.

items.name: eval_grade_bounded
items.statement: Fixpoint grade_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat := match e with | Basis _ => 1%nat | Scalar _ => 0%nat | Add e1 e2 => Nat.max (grade_bound e1) (grade_bound e2) | Mul e1 e2 => (grade_bound e1 + grade_bound e2)%nat | Conv e1 e2 => (grade_bound e1 + grade_bound e2)%nat end. Theorem eval_grade_bounded : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n), grade_bounded (eval_expr sq e) (grade_bound e).

items.name: max_grade_eval_le
items.statement: Corollary max_grade_eval_le : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n), (max_grade (eval_expr sq e) <= grade_bound e)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_during
items.statement: Fixpoint max_grade_during {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) : nat := match e with | Basis _ => 1%nat | Scalar _ => 0%nat | Add e1 e2 => Nat.max (max_grade_during sq e1) (max_grade_during sq e2) | Mul e1 e2 => Nat.max (Nat.max (max_grade_during sq e1) (max_grade_during sq e2)) (max_grade (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2))) | Conv e1 e2 => Nat.max (Nat.max (max_grade_during sq e1) (max_grade_during sq e2)) (max_grade (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2))) end.

items.name: max_grade_le_during
items.statement: Lemma max_grade_le_during : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n), (max_grade (eval_expr sq e) <= max_grade_during sq e)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_during_le_grade_bound
items.statement: Lemma max_grade_during_le_grade_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n), (max_grade_during sq e <= grade_bound e)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_during_eval_le_grade_bound
items.statement: Corollary max_grade_during_eval_le_grade_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n), (max_grade (eval_expr sq e) <= grade_bound e)%nat /\ (max_grade_during sq e <= grade_bound e)%nat.

items.name: excursion_lower_bound
items.statement: Theorem excursion_lower_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (F : MV n), eval_expr sq e = F -> (exists m : Mask n, (grade m >= n)%nat /\ ~(F m == 0)) -> (max_grade_during sq e >= n)%nat.

items.name: sign_to_bool
items.statement: Definition sign_to_bool (s : Sign) : bool := match s with Pos => true | Neg => false end.

items.name: XOR_n_func
items.statement: Definition XOR_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool := List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list (Vector.map sign_to_bool c)).

items.name: XOR_n_func_cons
items.statement: Definition XOR_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool := List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list (Vector.map sign_to_bool c)). Lemma XOR_n_func_cons : forall n (h : Sign) (c : Corner n), @XOR_n_func (S n) (Vector.cons _ h _ c) = xorb (sign_to_bool h) (@XOR_n_func n c).

items.name: bQ_negb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_negb : forall b : bool, bQ (negb b) == (1 - bQ b)%Q.

items.name: xor_sum
items.statement: Definition xor_sum (n : nat) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun a : Corner n => (bQ (@XOR_n_func n a) * chi' (Vector.const true n) a)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: embed_XOR_full_mask
items.statement: Definition xor_sum (n : nat) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun a : Corner n => (bQ (@XOR_n_func n a) * chi' (Vector.const true n) a)%Q) (all_corners n)). Lemma embed_XOR_full_mask : forall n, embed (@XOR_n_func n) (Vector.const true n) == ((1 / pow2 n) * xor_sum n)%Q.

items.name: chi_full_sum_zero
items.statement: Lemma chi_full_sum_zero : forall n, sumQ (List.map (fun a : Corner (S n) => chi' (Vector.const true (S n)) a) (all_corners (S n))) == 0.

items.name: xor_sum_base
items.statement: Lemma xor_sum_base : xor_sum 1 == 1.

items.name: sumQ_map_sub
items.statement: FunctionalExtensionality. Lemma sumQ_map_sub : forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A), sumQ (List.map (fun x => (f x - g x)%Q) l) == (sumQ (List.map f l) - sumQ (List.map g l))%Q.

items.name: xor_sum_step
items.statement: Lemma xor_sum_step : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> xor_sum (S n) == ((-2) * xor_sum n)%Q.

items.name: Qmul_nonzero_l
items.statement: Lemma Qmul_nonzero_l : forall p q : Q, ~(p == 0) -> ~(q == 0) -> ~(p * q == 0).

items.name: Qneg2_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma Qneg2_nonzero : ~((-2)%Q == 0).

items.name: Qinv_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma Qinv_nonzero : forall q : Q, ~(q == 0) -> ~(/q == 0).

items.name: Qdiv1_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma Qdiv1_nonzero : forall q : Q, ~(q == 0) -> ~((1 / q) == 0).

items.name: xor_sum_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma xor_sum_nonzero : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> ~(xor_sum n == 0).

items.name: XOR_has_grade_n_component
items.statement: Lemma XOR_has_grade_n_component : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> ~(embed (@XOR_n_func n) (Vector.const true n) == 0).

items.name: parity_excursion
items.statement: Theorem parity_excursion : forall n sq (e : GA_expr n), (n > 0)%nat -> eval_expr sq e = embed (@XOR_n_func n) -> (max_grade_during sq e >= n)%nat.

items.name: length_filter_le
items.statement: Lemma length_filter_le : forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A), (length (filter p l) <= length l)%nat.

items.name: NoDup_filter
items.statement: Lemma NoDup_filter : forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A), NoDup l -> NoDup (filter p l).

items.name: NoDup_incl_length
items.statement: Lemma NoDup_incl_length : forall (A : Type) (l1 l2 : list A), NoDup l1 -> incl l1 l2 -> (length l1 <= length l2)%nat.

items.name: filter_ext_in
items.statement: Lemma filter_ext_in : forall (A : Type) (l : list A) (p q : A -> bool), (forall x, In x l -> p x = q x) -> filter p l = filter q l.

items.name: all_masks_length_pow2
items.statement: Lemma all_masks_length_pow2 : forall n, length (all_masks n) = Nat.pow 2 n.

items.name: Qeq_bool_10
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_bool_10 : Qeq_bool 1 0 = false.

items.name: Qeq_bool_00
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_bool_00 : Qeq_bool 0 0 = true.

items.name: support_size
items.statement: Definition support_size {n} (F : MV n) : nat := length (List.filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0)) (all_masks n)).

items.name: support_size_ext
items.statement: Definition support_size {n} (F : MV n) : nat := length (List.filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0)) (all_masks n)). Lemma support_size_ext : forall n (F G : MV n), (forall m, F m == G m) -> support_size F = support_size G.

items.name: support_list
items.statement: Definition support_list {n} (F : MV n) : list (Mask n) := filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0)) (all_masks n).

items.name: support_size_le_2n
items.statement: Definition support_list {n} (F : MV n) : list (Mask n) := filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0)) (all_masks n). (* Lemma Block 1 *) Lemma support_size_le_2n : forall n (F : MV n), (support_size F <= Nat.pow 2 n)%nat.

items.name: support_size_zero
items.statement: Lemma support_size_zero : forall n, support_size (@mv_zero n) = 0%nat.

items.name: filter_all_false_nil
items.statement: Lemma filter_all_false_nil : forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A), (forall x, In x l -> p x = false) -> filter p l = [].

items.name: filter_singleton
items.statement: Lemma filter_singleton : forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A) (a : A), NoDup l -> In a l -> p a = true -> (forall x, In x l -> x <> a -> p x = false) -> filter p l = [a].

items.name: support_size_basis
items.statement: Lemma support_size_basis : forall n (i : Fin.t n), support_size (basis (mask_single i)) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_mv_one
items.statement: Lemma support_size_mv_one : forall n, support_size (@mv_one n) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_scale
items.statement: Lemma support_size_scale : forall n (c : Q) (F : MV n), ~(c == 0) -> support_size (mv_scale c F) = support_size F.

items.name: support_size_add
items.statement: Lemma support_size_add : forall n (F G : MV n), (support_size (mv_add F G) <= support_size F + support_size G)%nat.

items.name: support_size_conv
items.statement: Lemma support_size_conv : forall n (F G : MV n), (support_size (mv_conv F G) <= support_size F * support_size G)%nat.

items.name: support_size_bound
items.statement: Fixpoint support_size_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat := match e with | Basis _ => 1 | Scalar _ => 1 | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => support_size_bound e1 + support_size_bound e2 | Mul e1 e2 => match e1, e2 with | Scalar _, _ => support_size_bound e2 | _, Scalar _ => support_size_bound e1 | _, _ => Nat.pow 2 n end | Conv e1 e2 => support_size_bound e1 * support_size_bound e2 end.

items.name: eval_mul_scalar_l
items.statement: Lemma eval_mul_scalar_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n), forall m, eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar q) e) m == mv_scale q (eval_expr sq e) m.

items.name: eval_mul_scalar_r
items.statement: Lemma eval_mul_scalar_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n), forall m, eval_expr sq (Mul e (Scalar q)) m == mv_scale q (eval_expr sq e) m.

items.name: support_size_scalar_mul_l
items.statement: Lemma support_size_scalar_mul_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n), (support_size (eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar q) e)) <= support_size (eval_expr sq e))%nat.

items.name: support_size_scalar_mul_r
items.statement: Lemma support_size_scalar_mul_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n), (support_size (eval_expr sq (Mul e (Scalar q))) <= support_size (eval_expr sq e))%nat.

items.name: eval_support_size_le
items.statement: Theorem eval_support_size_le : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n), (support_size (eval_expr sq e) <= support_size_bound e)%nat.

items.name: formula_size
items.statement: Fixpoint formula_size {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : nat := match phi with | BVar _ => 1 | BConst _ => 1 | BAnd p q => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q | BOr p q => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q | BNot p => 1 + formula_size p end.

items.name: formula_size_pos
items.statement: Fixpoint formula_size {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : nat := match phi with | BVar _ => 1 | BConst _ => 1 | BAnd p q => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q | BOr p q => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q | BNot p => 1 + formula_size p end. Lemma formula_size_pos : forall n (phi : BoolFormula n), (formula_size phi >= 1)%nat.

items.name: pow2_pos
items.statement: Lemma pow2_pos : forall k, (1 <= Nat.pow 2 k)%nat.

items.name: pow2_ge_2
items.statement: Lemma pow2_ge_2 : forall k, (k >= 1)%nat -> (2 <= Nat.pow 2 k)%nat.

items.name: support_size_bound_translate
items.statement: Lemma support_size_bound_translate : forall n (phi : BoolFormula n), (support_size_bound (translate phi) <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: translate_support_size_bound
items.statement: Corollary translate_support_size_bound : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n), (support_size (eval_expr sq (translate phi)) <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: neg1_pow
items.statement: Definition neg1_pow (k : nat) : Q := if Nat.even k then 1%Q else (-(1))%Q.

items.name: neg1_pow_S
items.statement: Definition neg1_pow (k : nat) : Q := if Nat.even k then 1%Q else (-(1))%Q. Lemma neg1_pow_S : forall k, neg1_pow (S k) == (- neg1_pow k)%Q.

items.name: neg1_pow_neq_0
items.statement: Definition neg1_pow (k : nat) : Q := if Nat.even k then 1%Q else (-(1))%Q. Lemma neg1_pow_S : forall k, neg1_pow (S k) == (- neg1_pow k)%Q. Proof. intro k; unfold neg1_pow. rewrite Nat.even_succ. unfold Nat.odd. destruct (Nat.even k) eqn:Hev; simpl; ring. Qed. Lemma neg1_pow_neq_0 : forall k, ~(neg1_pow k == 0).

items.name: bQ_XOR_plus_chi
items.statement: Lemma bQ_XOR_plus_chi : forall n (s : Corner n), (2 * bQ (XOR_n_func s) + neg1_pow n * chi' (Vector.const true n) s == 1)%Q.

items.name: XOR_explicit
items.statement: Definition XOR_explicit {n} : MV n := mv_add (mv_scale (1#2) (basis mask_empty)) (mv_scale (- neg1_pow n * (1#2)) (basis (Vector.const true n))).

items.name: eval_XOR_explicit
items.statement: Definition XOR_explicit {n} : MV n := mv_add (mv_scale (1#2) (basis mask_empty)) (mv_scale (- neg1_pow n * (1#2)) (basis (Vector.const true n))). Lemma eval_XOR_explicit : forall n (s : Corner n), eval (@XOR_explicit n) s == bQ (XOR_n_func s).

items.name: embed_XOR_eq_explicit
items.statement: Lemma embed_XOR_eq_explicit : forall n (m : Mask n), embed (@XOR_n_func n) m == (@XOR_explicit n) m.

items.name: mask_empty_neq_full
items.statement: Lemma mask_empty_neq_full : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> @mask_empty n <> Vector.const true n.

items.name: XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n mask_empty == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_full_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma XOR_explicit_full_nonzero : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n (Vector.const true n) == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_other_zero
items.statement: Lemma XOR_explicit_other_zero : forall n (m : Mask n), m <> mask_empty -> m <> Vector.const true n -> @XOR_explicit n m == 0.

items.name: support_size_at_least_two
items.statement: Lemma support_size_at_least_two : forall n (F : MV n) (a b : Mask n), a <> b -> ~(F a == 0) -> ~(F b == 0) -> (2 <= support_size F)%nat.

items.name: support_size_basis_general
items.statement: Lemma support_size_basis_general : forall n (M : Mask n), support_size (basis M) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR_explicit_le
items.statement: Lemma support_size_XOR_explicit_le : forall n, (support_size (@XOR_explicit n) <= 2)%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR
items.statement: Lemma support_size_XOR : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) = 2%nat.

items.name: IP_raw
items.statement: Fixpoint IP_raw (l : list Sign) : bool := match l with | nil => false | _ :: nil => false (* odd — shouldn't happen *) | x :: y :: rest => xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y)) (IP_raw rest) end.

items.name: IP_n_func
items.statement: Definition IP_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool := IP_raw (Vector.to_list c).

items.name: IP_n_func_cons2
items.statement: Definition IP_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool := IP_raw (Vector.to_list c). Lemma IP_n_func_cons2 : forall n (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n), @IP_n_func (S (S n)) (Vector.cons _ x _ (Vector.cons _ y _ c)) = xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y)) (@IP_n_func n c).

items.name: signed
items.statement: Definition signed (b : bool) : Q := if b then (-1)%Q else 1%Q.

items.name: signed_xorb
items.statement: Definition signed (b : bool) : Q := if b then (-1)%Q else 1%Q. (* Step 2: signed is multiplicative over XOR *) Lemma signed_xorb : forall a b, signed (xorb a b) == (signed a * signed b)%Q.

items.name: signed_walsh
items.statement: Definition signed_walsh {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun a => (signed (f a) * chi' M a)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: bQ_via_signed
items.statement: Definition signed_walsh {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n) : Q := sumQ (List.map (fun a => (signed (f a) * chi' M a)%Q) (all_corners n)). (* Step 4: bQ in terms of signed *) Lemma bQ_via_signed : forall b, bQ b == ((1 - signed b) * (1#2))%Q.

items.name: AND_2
items.statement: Definition AND_2 (c : Corner 2) : bool := andb (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd c)) (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c))).

items.name: signed_walsh_2
items.statement: Definition signed_walsh_2 (f : Corner 2 -> bool) (b1 b2 : bool) : Q := signed_walsh f (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ (Vector.nil _))).

items.name: prod_pairs_raw
items.statement: Definition signed_walsh_2 (f : Corner 2 -> bool) (b1 b2 : bool) : Q := signed_walsh f (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ (Vector.nil _))). (* Product of 2-variable factors, one per coordinate pair *) Fixpoint prod_pairs_raw (l : list bool) : Q := match l with | [] => 1%Q | [_] => 1%Q (* odd — shouldn't happen *) | b1 :: b2 :: rest => (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs_raw rest)%Q end.

items.name: prod_pairs
items.statement: Definition prod_pairs (m : nat) (M : Mask (m + m)) : Q := prod_pairs_raw (Vector.to_list M).

items.name: Sn_plus_Sn
items.statement: Definition prod_pairs (m : nat) (M : Mask (m + m)) : Q := prod_pairs_raw (Vector.to_list M). (* The arithmetic fact *) Lemma Sn_plus_Sn : forall m, S (S ((m + m)%nat)) = (S m + S m)%nat.

items.name: mask_cast
items.statement: Definition mask_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1) : Mask n2 := eq_rect n1 (Vector.t bool) M n2 H.

items.name: to_list_cast
items.statement: Definition mask_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1) : Mask n2 := eq_rect n1 (Vector.t bool) M n2 H. (* KEY: to_list erases transport *) Lemma to_list_cast : forall n1 n2 (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1), Vector.to_list (mask_cast H M) = Vector.to_list M.

items.name: prod_pairs_cons2
