items.statement: Lemma prod_pairs_cons2 : forall m (b1 b2 : bool) (M : Mask (m + m)), prod_pairs (S m) (mask_cast (Sn_plus_Sn m) (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ M))) = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M)%Q.

items.name: vector_peel2
items.statement: Lemma vector_peel2 : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v : Vector.t A (S (S n))), exists (a1 a2 : A) (v' : Vector.t A n), Vector.to_list v = a1 :: a2 :: Vector.to_list v'.

items.name: Sm_plus_Sm
items.statement: Lemma Sm_plus_Sm : forall m, (S m + S m)%nat = (S (S (m + m)%nat)).

items.name: mask_decompose2
items.statement: Lemma mask_decompose2 : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)), exists b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)), Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M''.

items.name: prod_pairs_unfold
items.statement: Lemma prod_pairs_unfold : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)), forall b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)), Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M'' -> prod_pairs (S m) M = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M'')%Q.

items.name: inject_Z
items.statement: Definition inject_Z (z : Z) : Q := z # 1.

items.name: Qmult_eq_compat_l'
items.statement: Definition inject_Z (z : Z) : Q := z # 1. (* Step 5: embed in terms of signed_walsh *) Require Import Coq.Setoids.Setoid. Require Import Coq.Classes.Morphisms. Lemma Qmult_eq_compat_l' : forall a b c : Q, b == c -> a * b == a * c.

items.name: Qmult_eq_compat_r'
items.statement: Definition inject_Z (z : Z) : Q := z # 1. (* Step 5: embed in terms of signed_walsh *) Require Import Coq.Setoids.Setoid. Require Import Coq.Classes.Morphisms. Lemma Qmult_eq_compat_l' : forall a b c : Q, b == c -> a * b == a * c. Proof. intros a b c H; now setoid_rewrite H. Qed. Lemma Qmult_eq_compat_r' : forall a b c : Q, b == c -> b * a == c * a.

items.name: Qminus_eq_compat_l'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_eq_compat_l' : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> a - c == b - c.

items.name: Qminus_eq_compat_r'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_eq_compat_r' : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> c - a == c - b.

items.name: embed_via_signed_walsh
items.statement: Lemma embed_via_signed_walsh : forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n), embed f M == ((1 / pow2 n) * ((1#2) * (if mask_eq_dec M mask_empty then pow2 n else 0) - (1#2) * signed_walsh f M))%Q.

items.name: all_corners_2
items.statement: Lemma all_corners_2 : all_corners 2 = [Vector.cons _ Pos _ (Vector.cons _ Pos _ (Vector.nil _)); Vector.cons _ Pos _ (Vector.cons _ Neg _ (Vector.nil _)); Vector.cons _ Neg _ (Vector.cons _ Pos _ (Vector.nil _)); Vector.cons _ Neg _ (Vector.cons _ Neg _ (Vector.nil _))].

items.name: signed_walsh_AND_2var
items.statement: Lemma signed_walsh_AND_2var : forall (b1 b2 : bool), signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 == if b1 then (if b2 then (-2)%Q else (-2)%Q) else (if b2 then (-2)%Q else 2%Q).

items.name: all_corners_S
items.statement: Fixpoint *) Lemma all_corners_S : forall n, all_corners (S n) = map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos n c) (all_corners n) ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg n c) (all_corners n).

items.name: all_corners_SS
items.statement: Fixpoint *) Lemma all_corners_S : forall n, all_corners (S n) = map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos n c) (all_corners n) ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg n c) (all_corners n). Proof. intro n. simpl. reflexivity. Qed. (* 2-step split into 4 quadrants *) Lemma all_corners_SS : forall n, all_corners (S (S n)) = map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n) (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n) ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n) (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n) ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n) (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n) ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n) (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n).

items.name: chi'_cons2_factor
items.statement: Lemma chi'_cons2_factor : forall n (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n) (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n), chi' (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m)) (Vector.cons _ x _ (Vector.cons _ y _ c)) == ((if b1 then sQ x else 1%Q) * (if b2 then sQ y else 1%Q) * chi' m c)%Q.

items.name: to_list_inj
items.statement: Lemma to_list_inj : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v1 v2 : Vector.t A n), Vector.to_list v1 = Vector.to_list v2 -> v1 = v2.

items.name: corner_cast
items.statement: Definition corner_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (c : Corner n1) : Corner n2 := eq_rect n1 Corner c n2 H.

items.name: to_list_corner_cast
items.statement: Definition corner_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (c : Corner n1) : Corner n2 := eq_rect n1 Corner c n2 H. Lemma to_list_corner_cast : forall n1 n2 (H : n1 = n2) (c : Corner n1), Vector.to_list (corner_cast H c) = Vector.to_list c.

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_l_Qeq
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_l_Qeq : forall k x y : Q, k * (x + y) == k * x + k * y.

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_l
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_mul_l : forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q), sumQ (map (fun x => k * f x) l) == k * sumQ (map f l).

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq
items.statement: Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq : forall k x y : Q, (x + y) * k == x * k + y * k.

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_r
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_map_mul_r : forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q), sumQ (map (fun x => (f x * k)%Q) l) == (sumQ (map f l) * k)%Q.

items.name: chi_eq_chi'
items.statement: Lemma chi_eq_chi' : forall n (m:Mask n) (c:Corner n), chi m c == chi' m c.

items.name: sumQ_flat_map
items.statement: Lemma sumQ_flat_map : forall (A B : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> Q), sumQ (map f (flat_map g l)) == sumQ (map (fun a => sumQ (map f (g a))) l).

items.name: map_flat_map
items.statement: Lemma map_flat_map : forall (A B C : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> C), map f (flat_map g l) = flat_map (fun a => map f (g a)) l.

items.name: cons2
items.statement: Definition cons2 {n} (c2 : Corner 2) (x : Corner n) : Corner (S (S n)) := Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd c2) (S n) (Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c2)) n x).

items.name: all_corners_SS_flatmap
items.statement: Definition cons2 {n} (c2 : Corner 2) (x : Corner n) : Corner (S (S n)) := Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd c2) (S n) (Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c2)) n x). Lemma all_corners_SS_flatmap : forall n, all_corners (S (S n)) = flat_map (fun c2 : Corner 2 => map (fun x : Corner n => cons2 c2 x) (all_corners n)) (all_corners 2).

items.name: signed_walsh_tensor2
items.statement: Lemma signed_walsh_tensor2 : forall n (g : Corner 2 -> bool) (h : Corner n -> bool) (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n), signed_walsh (fun a : Corner (S (S n)) => xorb (g (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd a) _ (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd (Vector.tl a)) _ (Vector.nil _)))) (h (Vector.tl (Vector.tl a)))) (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m)) == (signed_walsh_2 g b1 b2 * signed_walsh h m)%Q.

items.name: signed_walsh_IP_factored
items.statement: Lemma signed_walsh_IP_factored : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)), signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == prod_pairs m M.

items.name: signed_walsh_IP_magnitude
items.statement: Lemma signed_walsh_IP_magnitude : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)), (m > 0)%nat -> exists s : bool, signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == signed s * inject_Z (Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat m)).

items.name: pow2_injectZ
items.statement: Lemma pow2_injectZ : forall n, pow2 n == inject_Z (2 ^ Z.of_nat n).

items.name: Zpow2_nat_eq_1
items.statement: Lemma Zpow2_nat_eq_1 : forall n, Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat n) = 1%Z -> n = 0%nat.

items.name: embed_IP_all_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma embed_IP_all_nonzero : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)), (m > 0)%nat -> ~ (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == 0).

items.name: support_size_IP
items.statement: Lemma support_size_IP : forall m, (m > 0)%nat -> support_size (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m))) = Nat.pow 2 (m + m).

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound
items.statement: Theorem IP_formula_size_lower_bound : forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)), (m > 0)%nat -> (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) -> (formula_size phi >= m)%nat.

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight
items.statement: Corollary IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight : forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)), (m > 0)%nat -> (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) -> (formula_size phi >= m + m)%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support
items.statement: Lemma formula_size_lower_bound_from_support : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool), (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = f -> (support_size (embed f) <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_k
items.statement: Corollary formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_k : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool) k, (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = f -> (k <= support_size (embed f))%nat -> (k <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_pow2
items.statement: Corollary formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_pow2 : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool) t, (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = f -> (Nat.pow 2 t <= support_size (embed f))%nat -> (t <= formula_size phi)%nat.

items.name: formula_size_full_support
items.statement: Corollary formula_size_full_support : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool), (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = f -> support_size (embed f) = Nat.pow 2 n -> (formula_size phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: support_size_embed_XOR
items.statement: Corollary support_size_embed_XOR : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) = 2%nat.

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound_via_full_support
items.statement: Corollary IP_formula_size_lower_bound_via_full_support : forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)), (m > 0)%nat -> (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) -> (formula_size phi >= m + m)%nat.

items.name: XOR_support_size_small
items.statement: Corollary XOR_support_size_small : forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> (support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) <= 2)%nat.

items.name: full_support_implies_size_ge_n
items.statement: Corollary full_support_implies_size_ge_n : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool), (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = f -> support_size (embed f) = Nat.pow 2 n -> (formula_size phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: occurs_var
items.statement: Fixpoint occurs_var {n} (i : Fin.t n) (phi : BoolFormula n) : Prop := match phi with | BVar j => i = j | BConst _ => False | BAnd p q => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q | BOr p q => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q | BNot p => occurs_var i p end.

items.name: length_filter_eq_Forall
items.statement: Fixpoint occurs_var {n} (i : Fin.t n) (phi : BoolFormula n) : Prop := match phi with | BVar j => i = j | BConst _ => False | BAnd p q => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q | BOr p q => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q | BNot p => occurs_var i p end. Lemma length_filter_eq_Forall : forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A), length (List.filter p l) = length l -> List.Forall (fun x => p x = true) l.

items.name: full_support_all_masks_nz
items.statement: Lemma full_support_all_masks_nz : forall n (F : MV n), support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n -> forall m, List.In m (all_masks n) -> negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0) = true.

items.name: nz_bool_to_neq0
items.statement: Lemma nz_bool_to_neq0 : forall q : Q, negb (Qeq_bool q 0) = true -> ~ q == 0.

items.name: full_support_all_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma full_support_all_nonzero : forall n (F : MV n), support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n -> forall m, In m (all_masks n) -> ~(F m == 0).

items.name: eval_bf_independent_if_not_occurs
items.statement: Lemma eval_bf_independent_if_not_occurs : forall n (phi : BoolFormula n) i, ~ occurs_var (n:=n) i phi -> forall c1 c2 : Corner n, (forall j, j <> i -> Vector.nth c1 j = Vector.nth c2 j) -> eval_bf phi c1 = eval_bf phi c2.

items.name: inner_sum_independent_zero
items.statement: Lemma inner_sum_independent_zero : forall n (i : Fin.t n) (f : Corner n -> bool), (forall c1 c2 : Corner n, (forall j : Fin.t n, j <> i -> Vector.nth c1 j = Vector.nth c2 j) -> f c1 = f c2) -> sumQ (List.map (fun a => (bQ (f a) * sQ (Vector.nth a i))%Q) (all_corners n)) == 0.

items.name: embed_mask_single_zero_if_independent
items.statement: Lemma embed_mask_single_zero_if_independent : forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (i : Fin.t n), (forall c1 c2 : Corner n, (forall j, j <> i -> Vector.nth c1 j = Vector.nth c2 j) -> f c1 = f c2) -> embed f (mask_single i) == 0.

items.name: full_support_implies_reads_all
items.statement: Corollary full_support_implies_reads_all : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool), (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) -> eval_bf phi = f -> support_size (embed f) = Nat.pow 2 n -> forall i, occurs_var i phi.

items.name: max_grade_of_full_support
items.statement: Theorem max_grade_of_full_support : forall n (F : MV n), support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n -> max_grade F = n.

items.name: full_support_implies_max_grade_n
items.statement: Theorem full_support_implies_max_grade_n : forall n (F : MV n), support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n -> max_grade F = n.

items.name: support_or_max_grade
items.statement: Corollary support_or_max_grade : forall n (F : MV n), support_size F <> Nat.pow 2 n \/ max_grade F = n.
